goal: Add Hadouken phrase as first class alias for down forward Destiny combo
body: Lexicon update: when Dave says 'hit this one with a Hadouken,' interpret it as the same execution command as 'relay down to relay forward to Destiny.' Execute three legs: persist into shards, relay forward across the fleet, and preserve the higher order direction for Destiny evolution. Treat as command semantics, not decorative language.

relay.note: Ratified 'Hadouken' command semantics: first-class alias for 'down forward to Destiny' combo (Persist shards -> Relay across fleet -> Preserve for Destiny evolution).
